_comment: Canonical fast-moving facts package-manager-ops encodes, and the tables scripts/pm-audit.py reads at run time (Node + PHP end-of-life dates, LTS codenames, native CLI names). scripts/check-pm-facts.py --offline asserts the skill prose names every token here; --live re-checks the tables against nodejs/Release schedule.json, php.net, the npm registry, getcomposer.org and GitHub. Edit deliberately: a change here changes what pm-audit reports. Verified 2026-10-05.

node._comment: From https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/Release/main/schedule.json. 'end' = end of life. Odd majors never reach LTS. From 27 on, one major per year and every line becomes LTS (nodejs.org blog, 2026-03-10). 26's codename is not assigned in schedule.json yet, so it is absent here on purpose: --live flags drift once it is.

php._comment: From https://www.php.net/supported-versions.php and https://www.php.net/eol.php. security_end = the day support ends; pm-audit treats a version as end-of-life the day after.

packages._comment: documented_major = the major the prose commits to. --live: DRIFT when the registry's latest major is ahead, or the package is gone.

npm.role: Node's bundled manager; Node 24/26 still bundle npm 11

corepack.role: standalone since Node 25 stopped bundling it

nvm-windows/nvm.role: Windows Node version manager (v2 rewrite, new repo)

text_watch._comment: Status statements the skill relies on. --live: DRIFT when the page no longer contains the phrase (the status changed - re-read and update the prose).

dated_facts._comment: Point-in-time facts the prose must state verbatim; --offline fails if a token disappears from SKILL.md/references.

composer._comment: From https://getcomposer.org/versions: the '1' channel is marked eol with maintenance-until. pm-audit's php.composer.v1 message quotes it; --live re-reads it.

native_cli_names._comment: Tools whose official channel is NOT the npm package of that bare name (winget/brew/apt/cargo/GitHub releases). `npx <name>` runs whatever owns that npm name - possibly a squatter. pm-audit flags npx.native-cli on these.
